column1: # As III — NIST ASD, captured 2026-08-14, register 1639.
# destination_url VERIFIED against sent. Levels in cm-1.
# CAPTURE ONLY. Nothing extracted per R 1638.
# ** THE FIRST n=4 CORE IN THE QUEUE. Every species so far has had a
#    3s/3p/3d core; As III's is 4s2, with the outer electron in 4p, 5s,
#    4d, 5p, 4f, 5d, 5g. THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT BOARD ROW 17 NEEDS —
#    the SAME subshell letters at a DIFFERENT shell. **
#    Al-like by electron count (4s2.4p ground, one electron outside a
#    closed s2), so it is directly comparable to K VII, Ca VIII, Sc IX
#    and Ti X — SAME structure, SHELL SHIFTED BY ONE.
#    ** THAT PAIRING IS THE CONTROLLED TEST ROW 17 ASKS FOR, and it
#       arrived from the reading list without being designed. **
# The 4s.4p2 and 4p3 blocks are TWO-ELECTRON-OUTSIDE states, not the
# one-electron series; kept but marked, since R 1597's keyability bound
# admits only one electron outside a closed shell.
# --- TWO electrons outside the closed 4s2. R 1597 keyability: refused.
